description: This file defines the Matcher class, which is a core model component managing matchers in the Goteo project. It includes properties, methods for retrieving, saving, and manipulating matchers, as well as managing related entities like projects, users, rewards, and location data. The class also handles validation, access control, and complex calculations related to matcher funding pools and project matching logic.

classes.name: Matcher
classes.description: Core model representing a Matcher entity, responsible for managing matching logic, project associations, user relationships, rewards, and validation within the Goteo crowdfunding platform.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve a matcher instance by its ID, optionally only active matchers, with optional language-specific fields.

methods.name: getFromProject
methods.description: Retrieve matchers associated with a given project, filtered by status and other optional filters.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Get a list of matchers based on filters, with pagination and optional count or sum of amounts.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persist the matcher entity to the database, including related pools and location data.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validate essential fields of the matcher before saving.

methods.name: getValidation
methods.description: Get validation score and errors for the matcher.

methods.name: getUserPools
methods.description: Retrieve user pools associated with the matcher.

methods.name: calculatePoolAmount
methods.description: Calculate total amount available in user pools for the matcher.

methods.name: calculateUsedAmount
methods.description: Calculate total used amount in the matcher based on investments.

methods.name: calculateCrowdAmount
methods.description: Calculate total amount contributed via civic funding efforts.

methods.name: calculateProjects
methods.description: Determine the total number of active projects linked to the matcher.

methods.name: addUsers
methods.description: Associate users to the matcher, optionally using their pools.

methods.name: getUsers
methods.description: Retrieve users linked to the matcher.

methods.name: removeUsers
methods.description: Remove user associations from the matcher.

methods.name: addProjects
methods.description: Add projects to the matcher with a specified status.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Retrieve projects associated with the matcher.

methods.name: getListProjects
methods.description: Retrieve a list of projects for display or processing.

methods.name: getSuccessPorcentage
methods.description: Calculate the success percentage of the matcher’s projects.

methods.name: findProject
methods.description: Find a specific project within the matcher context.

methods.name: getProjectStatus
methods.description: Get current status of a project for the matcher.

methods.name: removeProjects
methods.description: Remove projects from the matcher.

methods.name: useUserPool
methods.description: Toggle usage of user pools for funding within the matcher.

methods.name: setProjectStatus
methods.description: Update the status of a project associated with the matcher.

methods.name: updateProjectScore
methods.description: Recalculate and store the score for a project.

methods.name: getUserMatchersList
methods.description: List matchers managed by a specific user.

methods.name: getMatchersAvailable
methods.description: Find matchers available for a specific project based on location and status.

methods.name: hasQuestionnaire
methods.description: Determine if a matcher has an associated questionnaire.

methods.name: getQuestionnaire
methods.description: Retrieve the questionnaire associated with the matcher.

methods.name: activateMatchingRewards
methods.description: Enable matching rewards for this matcher.

methods.name: deactivateMatchingRewards
methods.description: Disable matching rewards for this matcher.

methods.name: matchesRewards
methods.description: Check if the matcher currently has rewards configured.

methods.name: getMatchingRewards
methods.description: Get list of rewards configured for the matcher.

methods.name: addMatchingReward
methods.description: Add a reward to the matcher.

methods.name: hasReward
methods.description: Check if the matcher has a specific reward.
